author: rApq
content: Shipped: PR #76 squash-merged. lean job split into lean-probe (1m32s) + lean-spine-forge sharded 4x (max shard 7m52s); lean stage wall-clock ~15-16min -> ~8min. Zero coverage loss (shards union = full -p forge; probe runs full axiom gate). Fixed mid-PR: lean-spine-forge must build Thermite.Strat.Cls.Wire for the REQ-4 differential battery. Option 1 (trim to spine-gated-only) documented as a future step needing a nextest test-group tag.
